create_qwen3moe_causal_lm: create a Qwen3MoE causal language model with vLLM config and load HuggingFace weights
build_qwen3moe_sparse_moe_block: build a sparse MoE block with routed experts, shared experts, and EP/TP parallelism support
run_qwen3moe_forward: run inference on a Qwen3MoE model passing input ids, positions, and optional intermediate tensors
load_qwen3moe_weights: load and map stacked and expert weights from HuggingFace checkpoint into Qwen3MoE model parameters
update_qwen3moe_expert_metadata: update physical expert metadata including redundant experts and local expert mappings for EP rebalancing
